summary: PhD in Electrical and Computer Engineering (University of Oklahoma, 2025) with computing-focused scholarship in machine learning, deep learning, generative and transfer learning, reinforcement learning, intelligent sensing and reproducible data science. Previously taught Computer Programming, Communication Systems and Wireless Communication to undergraduates; supported engineering laboratories and mentored Bachelor's and Master's research/project students. Applied AI engineering experience at AT&T, AT&T Labs and Futurewei connects learning methods and software with operational systems. Prepared to contribute to CS education in AI/ML, programming, data science and intelligent systems.
